children: BOSTON, MA, Sept. 08, 2026
Vystar Corporation
OTCQB:VYST

today announced the completion of a sale of substantially all remaining inventory associated with its Vytex business as the Company continues its strategic repositioning following its acquisition of the R3ALM Financial Ecosystem.

Vystar CEO Jamie Rotman stated, “I have completed a sale of substantially all remaining Vytex inventory, consisting of 1,395 individual pieces, including toppers, beds, pillows and covers. All of the inventory has now left our warehouse.”
The transaction represents another step in Vystar’s efforts to streamline its legacy operations and concentrate resources on the development of the R3ALM ecosystem.
Vystar’s Strategic Focus on R3ALM
Vystar is increasingly focused on R3ALM and its potential to participate in the rapidly developing market for tokenized real-world assets and on-chain financial instruments.

The tokenization sector remains in its early stages, while major financial institutions and consulting firms have projected substantial long-term growth as traditional financial assets—including investment funds, U.S. Treasuries, private credit and real estate—are increasingly represented on blockchain-based infrastructure.

R3ALM is being developed as a compliance-focused ecosystem designed to support tokenization, private-market transactions, digital capital formation and related financial applications. The platform is also intended to address opportunities associated with the global crowdfunding and private-capital markets.

“R3ALM represents a transformational evolution for Vystar,” said Jamie Rotman, CEO of Vystar. “This ecosystem positions us at the intersection of private markets, tokenization and AI—areas where we believe significant innovation in the future of finance will occur.”
RXAIR Strategic Divestiture

Vystar is also engaged with several interested parties regarding a potential sale of its RXAIR inventory and related assets. The assets are currently estimated by the Company to have a value in excess of $2 million.

The RXAIR assets include production tooling and two FDA Class II medical devices, providing a potential strategic opportunity for an industry-specific buyer seeking to acquire established product lines, manufacturing capabilities and related assets.
Vystar expects to provide additional updates regarding its strategic milestones and developments related to its RXAIR and Vytex divestiture efforts as appropriate.
The Company’s primary strategic focus continues to be the development and advancement of the R3ALM ecosystem.
About Vystar Corporation

Vystar Corporation is focused on identifying and advancing strategic opportunities that can enhance shareholder value and expand the Company’s participation in high-potential innovation markets. Through this proposed transaction with R3alm, Vystar is seeking to establish a meaningful position in the evolution of digital finance, tokenized assets, intelligent trust systems and modern capital markets infrastructure.
About R3alm

R3alm is building a compliance-focused AI and Web3 ecosystem designed to connect capital formation, tokenized assets, investor access, digital finance infrastructure, trust systems and intelligent automation. Its broader platform vision is intended to support both enterprise and consumer participation in the next generation of financial markets.
